'''Isgec Heavy Engineering Ltd''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|ɪ|z|dʒ|ɛ|k}} {{Respell|IZ|jek}};<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QJEO6m_-Q-M|title=Isgec Presses Film - English Version | Hydraulic Press | Mechanical Press | Servo Press|work=YouTube|date=August 8, 2019|access-date=4 September 2023}}</ref> formerly known as '''Indian Sugar and General Engineering Corporation''') is an Indian heavy [[engineering]] company. Established in 1933 as ''Saraswati Sugar Syndicate'', the company held a revenue of {{INRConvert|6245|c|lk=on|year=2024}} in 2024 with exports of approximately 92 countries.<ref>{{Cite web|title=ISGEC Heavy Eng Share Price|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/india/stockpricequote/engineering-heavy/isgecheavyengineering/SIS06|access-date=2021-02-25|website=www.moneycontrol.com|language=en}}</ref> It was ranked 252 in the [[The Economic Times|ET]] 2021<ref>{{Cite web|title=ET|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/isgec-heavy-engineering-ltd/stocks/companyid-12761.cms}}</ref> listing,<ref>{{cite news|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering Share Price, NSE/BSE Live Stock Price and Company Profile|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/saraswati-industrial-syndicate-ltd/stocks/companyid-12761.cms|access-date=13 May 2016|work=The Economic Times}}</ref> and 253 in the [[Fortune India 500]] Listings.<ref>{{Cite web|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering – Fortune 500 List 2020 – Fortune India|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/fortune-500/company-list/isgec-heavy-engineering?mode=search&query=isgec&year=2020|access-date=2021-02-25|website=www.fortuneindia.com|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/fortune-500/company-list/isgec-heavy-engineering?year=2017|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering - Fortune 500 List 2017 - Fortune India|website=www.fortuneindia.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite news| url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/saraswati-industrial-syndicate-ltd/stocks/companyid-12761.cms | work=The Times Of India | title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/india/bs1000_12/pdf/bs-1000-2012_03.pdf|title=Business Standard Link}}</ref>

The company deals with process equipment, [[Engineering, procurement, and construction|EPC projects]], industrial [[boiler]]s, [[Sugar plantation|sugar plants]], [[distilleries]], [[Mechanical press|mechanical]] and [[hydraulic press]]es, [[Steel casting|steel]] and iron castings, air pollution control equipment and contract manufacturing.<ref>{{Cite news|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd.|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/isgec-heavy-2167/information/company-history|access-date=2021-02-25}}</ref>

The company has its manufacturing plants and design offices spread across India; in [[Haryana]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[Gujarat]], [[Tamil Nadu]] and [[Maharashtra]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering > Location Details > Sugar > Location Details of ISGEC Heavy Engineering – BSE, NSE|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/isgecheavyengineering/locations/sis06|access-date=2021-02-25|website=www.moneycontrol.com|language=en}}</ref>

==History==
ISGEC originated from ''Saraswati Sugar Mills'' established in 1933, with a [[sugarcane]] crushing capacity of 400 tonnes per day. It has grown into one of India's largest [[sugar mills]] and now crushes 13,000 tonnes per day. It is today a [[Subsidiary|subsidiary company]]. At the time of the nation's [[Indian independence movement|independence]], the need for an Indian [[capital good]]s industry was recognized and ISGEC was established in 1946. The initial activity was the manufacture of spares for sugar mills. In the course of its history, the company diversified into a range of engineering products. In 1964, it established a joint venture with [[John Thompson (company)|John Thompson]] of the [[United Kingdom|UK]] to form ISGEC John Thompson. In 1981, it acquired majority shares in Uttar Pradesh Steels. Both units were subsequently absorbed into the parent company. In 2011, the company name was changed from Saraswati Industrial Syndicate Ltd. to ISGEC Heavy Engineering Ltd. with all businesses consolidated and now marketed under a common brand name – ISGEC.<ref name="auto"/><ref>{{Cite web|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering > Company History > Sugar > Company History of ISGEC Heavy Engineering – BSE, NSE|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/company-facts/isgecheavyengineering/history/sis06|access-date=2021-02-25|website=www.moneycontrol.com|language=en}}</ref>

In 2018, the company acquired 100% stake in Eagle Press & Equipment Co. Ltd., a Press manufacturing company in [[Windsor, Ontario|Windsor]] ([[Ontario]]) [[Canada]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/isgec-heavy-engineering-acquires-eagle-press-and-equipment-co-canada-and-its-group-companies-118091900615_1.html|title=ISGEC Heavy Engineering acquires Eagle Press and Equipment Co., Canada and its group companies|author=Capital Market|newspaper=Business Standard India |date=19 September 2018|via=Business Standard}}</ref>

==Operations==
Isgec has its manufacturing operations across [[Yamunanagar]], [[Dahej]], [[Bawal]] and [[Muzaffarnagar]], with offices in [[Noida]], [[Pune]], [[Chennai]], [[Mumbai]] and [[Kolkata]] in India. Spread over 100 hectares (250 acres), the company's manufacturing facilities have a shop floor area of over 55,000 square meters (66,400 square yards) with manufacturing and testing facilities.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.isgec.com/aboutus-locations.asp?lk=ab5|title=ISGEC / Heavy Engineering / Heavy Engineering Equipment Manufacturers|website=www.isgec.com}}</ref>

* [[ABB Group]], [[Switzerland]]
* [[Siemens]], [[Germany]]
* [[Foster Wheeler]], [[China]]
* [[Sumitomo]], [[Japan]]
* [[Foster Wheeler]], [[United States|U.S.]]
* [[Valeo]], [[France]]
* [[GE Hydro]], [[Canada]]
* [[Virginia Tech]], U.S.
* [[LuK]], [[Germany]]
* [[Wesfarmers]] Group, [[Australia]]

==Quality, safety and environment==
Over a period of eight decades, Isgec has been accredited by various standards organisations:<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.isgec.com/certificate.htm | title=Certification list | publisher=ISGEC | access-date=10 July 2011}}</ref>
* [[ISO 9001:2008]] Approval by [[Lloyd's Register]] of Quality Assurance<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.greenbusinesscentre.org/grn/events/BoilerSteam2008/images/ISGEC-Profile.pdf | title=Web Release | access-date=10 July 2011 }}{{Dead link|date=July 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{cite press release |url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/Markets/Company/Background/Company-Profile/Saraswati-Industrial-Syndicate-Ltd/533033 | title=India infoline | publisher=IIF | access-date=10 July 2011}}</ref>

==Joint ventures==
*Isgec Heavy Engineering Limited, India and [[Hitachi Zosen Corporation]], Japan have a joint venture – Isgec Hitachi Zosen Ltd. – for manufacturing specialized and critical process equipment. The new company has a shareholding pattern of 51% (Isgec) to 49% (Hitachi Zosen Corp.).<ref>[http://www.thehindu.com/business/companies/article3297289.ece Isgec, Hitachi form joint venture], [[The Hindu]], 9 April 2012</ref>
*A Joint Venture Company along with Amec Foster Wheeler North America Corp., U.S.A has been incorporated in the name of "Isgec Foster Wheeler Boilers" with a paid up capital of Rupees Two crore only.<ref>[http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/isgec-heavy-engineering-incorporates-jv-co-named-foster-wheeler-boilers-115040601144_1.html Isgec Amec Foster Wheeler for joint venture], [[Business Standard]], 6 April 2015</ref>
*Isgec and TITAN Metal Fabricators create joint venture manufacturing operation.<ref>[http://www.business-standard.com/content/b2b-manufacturing-industry/isgec-for-jv-with-us-based-titan-metal-fabricators-115062600578_1.html Isgec TITAN form joint venture], [[Business Standard]], 26 June 2015</ref>
*Isgec Heavy Engineering has formed a joint venture with Italy-based Redecam Group SpA.<ref>[http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/isgec-heavy-engg/article9517798.ece Isgec Redecam form joint venture], [[Hindu Business Line]], 2 February 2017</ref>

extract:
Isgec Heavy Engineering Ltd ( IZ-jek; formerly known as Indian Sugar and General Engineering Corporation) is an Indian heavy engineering company. Established in 1933 as Saraswati Sugar Syndicate, the company held a revenue of ₹6,245 crore (US$650 million) in 2024 with exports of approximately 92 countries. It was ranked 252 in the ET 2021 listing, and 253 in the Fortune India 500 Listings.
The company deals with process equipment, EPC projects, industrial boilers, sugar plants, distilleries, mechanical and hydraulic presses, steel and iron castings, air pollution control equipment and contract manufacturing.
The company has its manufacturing plants and design offices spread across India; in Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra.
